tool: built-in imagegen colour study with bounded native fabric tone transfer
prompt: Precise colour edit for a character-design consistency sheet. Image 1 is the edit target, an adult illustrated woman in a neutral T-pose wearing plain grey everyday two-piece underwear. Image 2 is the same adult character facing the opposite direction and is only a fabric-colour reference. In image 1 change only the grey clothing fabric to the lighter cool grey seen in image 2. Keep the existing garment shape, seams, outline, shading and coverage. Preserve her face, skin, hands, feet, anatomy, pose, exact placement, original 1024x1536 canvas and transparency. Do not redraw or alter anything other than the clothing colour. Return one edited version of image 1, with a true transparent background and no labels or extra panels.

referenceInputs.role: Edit target: exact approved SW revision-4 anatomy.
Accepted SE colour reference only; no copied geometry.

method: Median per-channel fabric offset from the colour study, applied only to bounded original neutral fabric pixels, fading to zero at dark outlines; source alpha and geometry unchanged.
notes: Generated image supplies colour only; its anatomy, linework, skin and alpha are unselected. Original native shading variation is retained.
The selection uses explicit bra/brief bounds and neutral-fabric material tests; no alpha is colour-keyed or erased.
